scope: Bounded R2-R3 source/convention work for existing HTT inference; no new broad research loop

observed_coefficients.C_lm: Must carry field label and units; full phase/component information
observed_coefficients.C_l_theory: Named ensemble/statistical power; distinct from a specific sky realization

conventions.directions: e=-n; e photon propagation, n outward sky
conventions.I: Physical bolometric energy density per solid angle [J m^-3 sr^-1]

hierarchy.definition: J^(i)_<A_l>=integral E v^(l+2i) e_<A_l> f dnu_U
hierarchy.MGE_older_label: Footnote11 uses J^(l)_A_l=Delta_l Pi_A_l; its superscript labels angular rank in that notation
hierarchy.warning: Do not reuse a bare superscript n until its defining integral is identified

harmonic_STF.real_basis: J=(-1)^l sqrt(Delta_l) sum_a b_la E_la for orthonormal STF E

temperature_conversion.domain: Planck ray temperatures or full-bolometric-energy calibrated T_E; a generic channel thermodynamic-K map requires its spectral/calibration model

quadratic_joint_pi.inputs: Theta=d.n+Q:nn+O:nnn; Q,O STF; allO(Theta); zero angular monopole
quadratic_joint_pi.formula: pi/rho=8Q/15+4STF(dd)/5+24 d^c O_abc/35+16 STF(Q_ac Q_bc)/35+8 STF(O_acd O_bcd)/35+O(Theta^3)
quadratic_joint_pi.check: Independent exact isotropic moment pairing counts
quadratic_joint_pi.zero_terms: dQ and QO have odd parity
quadratic_joint_pi.rho_normalization: Changes first-order pi only at cubic order for meanTheta=0

specific_source_discrepancy.adopted: Denominator8, consistent with direct angular integration and attached prior report
specific_source_discrepancy.verification: PDF page15 rendered and visually inspected; equations47/49/50/80 read
specific_source_discrepancy.scope: Localized factor-four display inconsistency; no journal erratum claimed

bandpass.measured: Band-weighted spectral-radiance harmonics with actual response beam/mask/fit operator
bandpass.bolometric_requirement: Calibrated spectral completion or bounded omitted-band contribution
bandpass.finite_energy_transport: integral_E1^E2 E^4 partial_E f dE=[E^4 f]_E1^E2 -4 integral_E1^E2 E^3 f dE
bandpass.consequence: Keep endpoint terms; uncorrected bolometric hierarchy is not independent per-band transport

physically_constrainable: Observer-event radiation tensors from calibrated moments; matter shear/vorticity/acceleration/tilt/curvature additionally require registered physical response and derivative/nuisance inputs
